displayName: Macy's Product Data API - Search, Prices, Reviews, Store Pickup
description: Macy's product data as structured JSON - search macys.com or browse any category, brand page or sale section (Sales & Offers, Clearance, Today Only, Last Act, Limited-Time Specials, Black Friday), 60 products per page with current, regular and sale price, percent off, sale end date, deal label, promotions, rating and colors, filtered by brand, color, special offer, any price range, store pickup or any facet, read one product with every variant (UPC, color, size, availability), the rating histogram and fit slider, or batch up to 10 products in one call, page Macy's own reviews up to 100 at a time, find stores near a ZIP, a point or a city, check store pickup for a product near you or per variant at one store, and pull search autocomplete. 9 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
